text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, The Hanshin J.F. racecourse was something else! The atmosphere was totally different from when I debuted!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Every other Umamusume was so confident and cool. I was worried I wasn't gonna be able to run well enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But guess who I saw when I went into the waiting room! It was my best bud, Mifuyu! (Trainer asked her to come!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: With her cheering me on, there was no way I could put on a crummy performance! Thanks to her, I was primed and ready to win!
